description: Define the candidate field for a party's presidential primary on this simulation (the GOP/Dem contenders). Persisted on the sim so the browser and AI share one roster. Shares set via set_primary_shares reference these…

candidates.description: Array of contenders: [{id?, name, party?, color?, home_state?, incumbency?, ideology?}]. Replaces the party's primary roster. Omitted colors are auto-assigned distinct palette hues.

color.description: Optional hex color; omitted → a distinct auto-assigned palette color.

id.description: Optional stable id (e.g. "newsom"). Auto-minted as c_<n> when omitted.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: set_primary_candidates
